Upper Text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Night Claw]/[Light Fang] trait: Cost 4

[When Digivolving][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] For each of this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash any 1 digivolution card from 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, until the end of your opponent's turn, all of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't suspend.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon's digivolution card is trashed, unsuspend this Digimon.
